newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends down on lower CBOT soy complex.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends down on lower CBOT soy complex.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended lower, pulled down by a slide in CBOT soycomplex values but underpinned by crusher, fund and exporter demand, traders said.

"This was a key reversal day. We started lower, went up by midday then followed the beans down but Winnipeg outperformed Chicago on good crusher and fund demand," a trader said. March canola futures crush margin fell to -24.55 Monday from -21.78 Friday. March-May spread at $0.40, May-July at even money, May Nov $41.50. Volume was 10,419 lots with 1,340 hedges.
Japan bought 1,000-2,000 tonnes overnight, sources said.
March canola fell $0.50 to close at $414 in the May, down $0.20 to $413.70.
May flax fell $1 to $351 on 250 hedges. May-July $1.
March western barley rose $0.70 to $139 on commission house demand and May rose $0.50 to $138.50. Seventy-five Mar-May spread from even money to $0.20. Volume was 800 lots.
March feed wheat rose $1.30 to $170 on commercial liquidation, May rose $0.20 to $166 on commercial demand. Mar-May spread at $3.50, May-July $3. Volume was 1,185 lots.
Oats and feed peas did not trade.
(Values in Canadian dollars/tonne except oats and peas.)
